card.category: file host (free 100 GB account, guest upload)
card.summary: Every registered free account gets a 100GB free cloud storage pool; guests can upload without an account; downloads are not throttled and carry no countdown ...

record.category: file host (free 100 GB account, guest upload)

free_tier.stated: Every registered free account gets a 100GB free cloud storage pool; guests can upload without an account; downloads are not throttled and carry no countdown timer.

retention.stated: guest uploads expire after 30 days of inactivity; registered files are not swept by an automatic expiry

egress.terms: No speed cap and no forced countdown for recipients; the site is funded by ads on download pages. No download volume figure is published on the pages read.

record.interface_detail: WebDAV mount, FTPS (explicit TLS) on port 21 for registered accounts, and a public API, all described on the FAQ page; none was probed.
record.tooling: Browser upload, WebDAV mount, FTPS clients such as FileZilla, and a public API (all per the FAQ).
record.chaining: A 100 GB free account with WebDAV, FTPS and an API at no charge; no paid plan appears on the pages read.

limits.value: 100GB of storage per free account; uploads pause when the quota is full
guest uploads expire after 30 days of inactivity

record.binding_note: The 100 GB pool is the ceiling on a free account; the 5 GB per-file cap applies inside it.

identity_cost.detail: A free account is created from a register form; its fields were not read. Guests can upload without an account and those files expire after 30 days of inactivity.

record.reliability_note: The FAQ states one free account per individual or business.
record.confidence_note: Quota, cap, expiry and interfaces read on the vendor FAQ page. Cheapest paid tier: unverified: no paid plan appears on the pages read.

evidence.proved: the home page advertises 100 GB of free storage

evidence.quote: You can upload individual files up to 5GB in size.
will expire automatically after 30 days of inactivity
evidence.proved: guest uploads expire after 30 days of inactivity

evidence.quote: Every registered account has access to our high speed data ingest layer via secure FTPS (FTP over Explicit TLS) on Port 21
evidence.proved: registered accounts have FTPS on port 21

evidence.quote: Is there a public API available for automated workflows?
evidence.proved: a public API is described on the FAQ page

evidence.quote: No. We never throttle your bandwidth.
By registering, you agree to our [Terms](https://www.udrop.com/terms) & [Privacy](https://www.udrop.com/privacy) Policies.
evidence.proved: a register form exists at the register page

record.notes: The FAQ claims the free tier is sustained by advertising on download pages.
